♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: With the Moon in Virgo in Hasta nakshatra moving through your 6th house, today is about precision, problem‑solving and reclaiming control over your routines. Jupiter newly in Leo in Magha in your 5th fires up confidence and creative courage, while Mars in late Cancer in Ashlesha energizes your 4th house, stirring domestic restlessness. The Sun and retrograde Mercury in Swati, plus retrograde Venus at the tail of Virgo in Chitra, keep your 7th and 6th houses strongly activated: how you cooperate, how you serve, and how you negotiate your space with others.

💼 Career: The 6th‑house Moon highlights systems, small errors and the quality of your craftsmanship. This is a strong day to clean up a backlog, fix something that’s been “good enough,” or streamline how you handle repetitive tasks. Swati Sun–Mercury in your 7th puts partners, clients and contracts under the microscope; a misalignment in expectations may finally become clear. Rather than pushing through with force, use your Magha‑Jupiter confidence to calmly reset terms or boundaries. Mars in your 4th can make you sensitive to work spilling into home, so consciously separate focus time from rest time.

❤️ Love: With Venus retrograde at the end of your 6th, what you do for each other on ordinary days matters more than grand romance. You may suddenly notice imbalances around chores, emotional labor or practical support. The Swati emphasis in your 7th favors fair, balanced conversation: listen as much as you argue your case. If partnered, choose one concrete shift you can both commit to—a shared errand, a tech‑free hour, or a new household routine that eases pressure. If single, you may feel drawn to people whose lives are well‑organized and who respect your independence in daily life.

💰 Money: Virgo–Venus themes land in the zone of work and expenses: subscriptions or services tied to productivity, health or pets might be up for review. You could identify a few regular outlays that no longer earn their keep. Jupiter in your 5th favors considered risks and investments in learning or children, but Ashlesha Mars warns against emotional or family‑pressured spending. Ask whether a purchase is genuinely stabilizing your foundations or just soothing a temporary mood.

🧘 Advice: Treat your day like a finely tuned practice—small, repeatable adjustments will support you far more than one dramatic overhaul.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The real upgrade today is hidden in how you handle the unglamorous details.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Hasta lights up your 5th house of joy, intelligence, children and creative output. Your ruler Venus, still retrograde at the very end of Virgo in Chitra, deepens your reflection on what pleasure and refinement truly mean for you now. Jupiter in early Leo in Magha activates your 4th house of emotional roots, while Mars in Ashlesha in Cancer charges your 3rd house of courage and communication. This is a day to translate inner inspiration into tangible expression.

💼 Career: The 5th‑house Moon sharpens your problem‑solving and design eye. You’re well‑placed to polish presentations, improve user experience, refine teaching materials, or make your work visually and structurally cleaner. Retrograde Venus in your 5th/6th cusp suggests going back to an earlier idea, format or client niche that once brought genuine satisfaction. Mars in your 3rd lends assertiveness to your speech—use it to pitch, follow up or clarify, but avoid over‑explaining from defensiveness. A brief, well‑crafted message can move a stalled situation forward.

❤️ Love: Hasta Moon turns your attention to the simple, crafted gestures of affection: a carefully worded message, a small gift with meaning, or showing up reliably when promised. With Magha Jupiter in your 4th, your heart wants warmth and a sense of belonging, not drama. If partnered, shared enjoyment—cooking together, playing with kids, revisiting an old hobby—can reset connection more effectively than dissecting problems. If single, someone who has been in your environment for a while (neighbor, colleague, fellow student) may suddenly stand out as a more serious prospect.

💰 Money: Creative or child‑related expenses may feature, but the Virgo emphasis encourages intelligent planning rather than denial or indulgence. You might review costs for courses, activities or passion projects and prioritize the few that genuinely enhance your skills or happiness. Jupiter in the 4th can bring medium‑term opportunities linked to property, relocation or family support, so consider how today’s smaller choices align with that longer arc.

🧘 Advice: Give your heart permission to prefer quality over intensity—steady, crafted joys will feed you more than sporadic highs.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop apologizing for what you truly enjoy, life quietly rearranges in your favor.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Hasta moves through your 4th house, drawing attention to home, inner security and emotional digestion. Your ruler Mercury is retrograde in Swati in Libra in your 5th, revisiting old creative ideas, romantic scripts and how you seek validation. Venus retrograde at the end of Virgo sits close to your IC, while Jupiter in Magha in Leo boosts your 3rd‑house curiosity. Mars in Ashlesha in Cancer activates your 2nd house of speech and resources. Thoughts, memories and family patterns interweave in a practical way today.

💼 Career: While the outer pace may feel moderate, the inner re‑ordering is significant. The 4th‑house Moon favors working from a stable, organized base—clearing clutter, adjusting your workspace or rethinking your daily flow. Swati Mercury in your 5th is excellent for revising drafts, re‑timing launches, or re‑framing how you present your talents. Mars in your 2nd sharpens your financial awareness and your voice; you may be less willing to undersell yourself or stay silent about unfair compensation. Stick to clear facts and examples rather than using sharp words to make your point.

❤️ Love: With your 4th and 5th both lit, you may feel both nostalgic and experimental. Old crushes, past relationships or half‑finished love stories could cross your mind—or your inbox. The question is less “Should I go back?” and more “What does this memory show me about what I need now?” For those partnered, small improvements in your shared home environment—rearranging a room, creating a cozy corner, cooking something comforting—can have an outsized emotional impact. If single, clarity about your non‑negotiables in emotional safety will help you sort playful flirtation from truly viable connection.

💰 Money: Mars in your 2nd and the Virgo Moon encourage sensible budgeting and decisive clean‑up. You might finally cancel something you rarely use, ask for pending payments, or set a more realistic spending boundary with yourself or family. Jupiter in your 3rd supports learning around money—reading, short courses, or conversations with people who handle resources in ways you admire.

🧘 Advice: Notice which environments calm your system and which agitate it; your nervous system is giving you precise information today.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you arrange your space now is quietly teaching your mind how it’s allowed to feel.
cancer:

leo:

Magha Jupiter in your 1st gives you the courage to re‑introduce yourself—to update your title, adjust your rates, or step forward for opportunities you once hesitated to claim. Swati Sun–Mercury supports clear writing and negotiation; proposals, emails and important calls can benefit from your refined articulation. The 3rd‑house Swati energy encourages open dialogue, and you might find it easier than usual to name subtle dissatisfactions without drama. If partnered, grounding affection through simple physical comforts—sharing a meal, giving a massage, tidying a shared space—can be more nourishing than heavy conversations. If single, attraction could spark through well‑crafted messages or discussions where you feel truly heard.

Review your current earning mix, small luxuries, and recurring expenses that relate to status or image. Ask whether they still reflect who you’re becoming under Magha’s influence. A modest adjustment—cutting one vanity expense, adding one savings habit, charging slightly closer to your real worth—can compound significantly over time.

🧘 Advice: Let your pride inspire better stewardship, not just bigger displays; how you handle your resources is part of your radiance.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your money choices match your true priorities, confidence stops needing constant outside confirmation.
virgo:

libra:

Swati Sun–Mercury in your 1st can bring reviews, feedback or revisits to your public image—old contacts may reappear, or you may feel called to adjust how you’re seen in professional spaces. A quiet review today may reveal where you can simplify without feeling deprived. Jupiter in the 11th supports longer‑term gains from communities and networks; consider whether a membership, association or group is worth its cost in both money and energy.

scorpio:

sagittarius:

capricorn:
